name: NAVER
description: NAVER’s HyperCLOVA / HyperCLOVA X is the company’s flagship Korean-centric LLM family, with public releases and research artifacts distributed via NAVER Cloud channels (e.g., GitHub and Hugging Face). NAVER is headquartered in Seongnam-si, Gyeonggi Province, South Korea.

sources.notes: NAVER's official company page lists its headquarters at NAVER 1784, 95 Jeongjail-ro, Bundang-gu, Seongnam-si, Gyeonggi Province, South Korea.

verification.notes: Location metadata verified for the parent company; the broader catalogue record was not re-audited.
